at ./src/*.js — this package ships its source, unbundled, and a build step

The include list is deliberately narrow. Turning `checkJs` loose on the
whole tree at once produces hundreds of findings in code that has shipped
and works, which is a backlog rather than a gate. New modules join the list
as they are written, and the list only grows.
